message: Function parameters must use a stable parameter prefix convention

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' parameters must use the a_ prefix (language receivers self/cls, protocol slots, and *args/**kwargs keep conventional names)

rationale: A stable parameter prefix distinguishes application parameters from locals. Universal out-of-scope: dunder methods, UI event handlers (on_*), and well-known language/stdlib protocol method names (filter/emit/format/compose for logging and UI composition protocols). Protocol parameter slots (record, event, exc_type/val/tb) keep their conventional names. Not project-path specific.
remediation: Rename application parameters with the a_ prefix, e.g. def process(a_path: Path, a_limit: int). Keep self/cls, protocol slots, and *args/**kwargs unchanged.
